title: Mixed conditionals - Past condition, present result and vice versa

options.answer: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If I had studied medicine, I will be a doctor now.
If I studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.

explanation.en: This is a mixed conditional combining a past condition with a present result. We use 'had + past participle' for the past condition and 'would + base verb' for the present result.
explanation.ru: Это смешанное условное предложение, сочетающее прошлое условие с настоящим результатом. Мы используем 'had + причастие прошедшего времени' для прошлого условия и 'would + основной глагол' для настоящего результата.
explanation.uz: Bu o'tmishdagi shart bilan hozirgi natijani birlashtiradigan aralash shartli gap. O'tmishdagi shart uchun 'had + o'tmish zamon sifatdoshi' va hozirgi natija uchun 'would + asosiy fe'l' ishlatamiz.

options.answer: If she was more confident, she would have got the job yesterday.
If she were more confident, she would have gotten the job yesterday.
If she is more confident, she would have got the job yesterday.

explanation.en: This mixed conditional uses a present hypothetical condition with a past result. We use 'were' (subjunctive) for the present condition and 'would have + past participle' for the past result.
explanation.ru: Это смешанное условное предложение использует настоящее гипотетическое условие с прошлым результатом. Мы используем 'were' (сослагательное наклонение) для настоящего условия и 'would have + причастие прошедшего времени' для прошлого результата.
explanation.uz: Bu aralash shartli gapda hozirgi faraziy shart o'tmishdagi natija bilan ishlatiladi. Hozirgi shart uchun 'were' (shart mayli) va o'tmishdagi natija uchun 'would have + o'tmish zamon sifatdoshi' ishlatamiz.
